name: Clea Glaive
source:
"...All right, who wants to start the bidding?"

She travels far and wide, selling to souls who live in a broken world...

The infamous Red Peddler, who is introduced as a dubious merchant before joining [url=/c84006]Shiina's[/url] party. Her obsession with flipping antique goods often gets her into trouble, but she has a keen knowledge for priceless goods and weapons. Despite her rapacious veneer, she makes for a reliable ally.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Hiizumi Kaede (樋泉 楓). She is [url=/c84034]Senji's[/url] daughter.[/spoiler]
